steps.t: Set up the catalogue to your design.
steps.d: Products, collections and variants are structured so the store matches your designs and your client can add more.

steps.t: Build the product page on a phone first.
steps.d: The theme is customised around the mobile product page, where most D2C visits happen.

steps.t: Cut apps and speed up the store.
steps.d: Apps you do not need come out and images are tuned, so your client's store is not slowed by add-ons.

steps.t: Set up checkout and payment options.
steps.d: UPI, cards, wallets and cash on delivery are configured with your client's gateway, and tested before launch.
Repeat-buyer segments and reminders are set up, with notes your client's team can run.
